# Gyblos Explorer

> Live, public metrics of the Gyblos peer-to-peer AI inference network on Solana: which sellers are online, which models they serve and at what price, their uptime, how many requests the network served, and what Gyblos payment channels settled on chain.

Gyblos is an open market where anyone can sell, buy or give away AI inference. The explorer at https://explorer.gyblos.com shows the network as it is, from public sources only. It is on Solana devnet during the beta; mainnet is planned for 2026-12-09.

## How to read the figures

- Free and paid usage are always shown as a pair ("free · paid") and never added together: free volume is not backed by payment.
- Usage comes from signed receipts that sellers and buyers report to the metrics collector. The request count includes requests only the seller reported; requests both sides reported are matched first.
- Buyer counts below 5 are withheld and shown as "< 5", never as zero.
- Amounts are USDC, computed from exact atomic units. Times are UTC.
- "Gyblos" channel figures come from payment channels whose opening transaction carries a Gyblos memo. That label is self-declared by whoever opens the channel.
- A ✓ next to a seller means the discovery index checked that the named GitHub account published the seller's NodeId in a gist; it links the seller to that account, does not identify a person and says nothing about quality. Sellers without it are not marked. Online sellers with at least 7 days of history come first, by whole-percent 7-day uptime and then by lowest paid output price; newer sellers follow, by price. `?verified=1` shows only verified sellers, online or not.
- A seller is online when it has a live signed presence in the discovery index, offline when it was seen before but has none now, and not published when it was never seen or withdrew its catalog.
- Channel transactions list the latest instructions of Gyblos payment channels on chain (channels whose open carries a Gyblos memo or whose distribute pays the Gyblos treasury), all time and newest first, not filtered by the range; `?before=<cursor>` pages to older ones. Each amount is per row (deposit in, newly settled, what the seller got, or the refund) and must not be added up; a payout row also shows how it split between the seller, the Gyblos fee, the program treasury and the refund to the buyer. The seller is shown when the channel's payout recipient equals the owner address of exactly one listed seller; that owner is self-declared, so it is a display hint, not proof. Otherwise the row says "Unlisted seller".
- The page shows the last 7, 30 or 90 days (`?range=7`, `?range=30`, `?range=90`); 30 is the default.

## Public data sources

- [Discovery index](https://discovery.gyblos.com/v1/models): models offered now; `/v1/sellers?model=<id>` lists live sellers, `/v1/uptime?node=<NodeId>` a seller's uptime, and `/v1/network` every registered seller's online, offline or not-published state.
- [Metrics collector](https://collector.gyblos.com/v1/stats/network): daily network totals; `/v1/stats/models` per model and `/v1/stats/chain` on-chain settlements. Each takes `from` and `to` as `YYYY-MM-DD`, at most 92 days. `/v1/stats/chain/txs` lists Gyblos channel transactions, newest first, paged with `before` and `limit`.
